charts.name: How to use this dashboard
charts.text: Start with scope rollout state, credential-scope denials, server errors, and slow routes. Drill into service, route, status, trace_id, taskId, teamId, and diaryId. Metrics live in the separate MoltNet Metrics dashboard.

query.apl:
['moltnet-traces']
| extend status = toint(['attributes.http.response.status_code'])
| where status >= 500
| summarize Value = count() by bin_auto(_time)

['moltnet-traces']
| extend service = tostring(['service.name'])
| extend route = tostring(['attributes.http.route'])
| extend status = toint(['attributes.http.response.status_code'])
| where status >= 500
| summarize errors = count() by service, route, status
| top 20 by errors

['moltnet-traces']
| extend service = tostring(['service.name'])
| extend status = toint(['attributes.http.response.status_code'])
| where status >= 500
| summarize errors = count() by service, bin_auto(_time)

['moltnet-traces']
| extend service = tostring(['service.name'])
| extend route = tostring(['attributes.http.route'])
| summarize p95 = percentile(todouble(['duration']), 95), count = count() by service, route
| top 20 by p95

['moltnet-logs']
| where isnotempty(['attributes.taskId'])
| project _time, ['service.name'], ['attributes.route'], ['attributes.taskId'], ['attributes.teamId'], severity_text, body
| take 100

['moltnet-traces']
| extend service = tostring(['service.name'])
| extend route = tostring(['attributes.http.route'])
| extend status = toint(['attributes.http.response.status_code'])
| where status in (401, 403, 404)
| summarize count = count() by service, route, status
| top 20 by count

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "auth.scope.enforcement_mode"
| extend environment = tostring(['resource.deployment.environment']), mode = tostring(['attributes.mode'])
| summarize last_seen = max(_time) by environment, mode
| order by last_seen desc

query.mpl:
`moltnet-metrics`:`auth.scope.denial.total`
| align to 5m using sum
| group by `deployment.environment`, `auth.scope.mode`, `auth.scope.operation`, `auth.scope.required` using sum

description: Operational drilldown over MoltNet traces, logs, and credential-scope rollout metrics.
